title: Inclusive by Design: A Library's Small Changes · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (about 100 words) about a small change you would like to make in your school or workplace to help more people. Explain what the change is and why it is useful.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
